caption: The drawing features a shield with a golden-yellow border as its central object. The top part of the shield is blue and contains two silver or gray animal figures, which appear to be lions or similar creatures, facing each other. Below the blue section, the shield has vertical red and white stripes with small letters written on the stripes. Above the shield, there is a brown eagle with wings spread outward, its head pointing to the right, holding a green branch with leaves in its beak. The entire emblem is placed on a textured, off-white background that appears quilted or stitched. Below the shield, there is a flowing red banner with the text "E PLURIBUS UNUM" written in uppercase white letters. The colors used are primarily gold-yellow, blue, red, white, gray, brown, and green. The composition centers the shield, eagle, and banner, with all elements fully enclosed within the field of the drawing.
title: Block from Friendship Quilt
